answer: The system issues each new AI identity a digital plume of reputation tokens that vest linearly over an atlas of epochs, releasing an ember of reward only after the previous epoch’s stake is locked. Because vesting is rate‑limited, an attacker must fund every synthetic identity with full collateral each epoch, turning the cost of a Sybil farm into a predictable sum of real resources rather than a one‑time mint. Consequently, scaling the attack requires proportional capital, making large‑scale fake‑identity campaigns economically unfeasible.
